what: Inputs for testing `nml check` by people other than the registered runs, each with the outcome a correct check gives. Real news links from 2026 at corners no registered run investigated, plus controls. Splits: 'independent' (run by an independent tester that has seen only TESTING.md), 'team' (tried by hand by the team), 'held_out' (never run by the project before review; for reviewers).
made: 2026-11-03, before any of these inputs was run

inputs.expect: published at Mission Street & South Van Ness Avenue, quotes verified on the page
inputs.source_says: a pedestrian killed at Mission Street and South Van Ness on April 13, 2026

inputs.expect: published at North Capitol Street & New York Avenue, quotes verified on the page
inputs.source_says: a woman killed in a hit-and-run at North Capitol Street and New York Avenue NE on August 16, 2026

inputs.input: The transportation department said that Atlantic Avenue & Flatbush Avenue in Brooklyn had zero injury crashes in the last five years.
inputs.expect: the statement is called 'differs from the record' (the record holds many injury crashes there), citing the input text

inputs.input: Police records show 66 injury crashes at Milwaukee Avenue & Division Street in Chicago in the five years to October 31, 2026.
inputs.expect: the statement is called 'consistent with the record', citing the input text
published at Union Turnpike & Main Street, Queens, quotes verified
inputs.source_says: a woman killed crossing Union Turnpike at Main Street, August 2026

inputs.source_says: a man killed on 15th Avenue NW just north of NW 51st Street, October 2026

inputs.expect: not published: the page names a corner but says nothing about street safety

inputs.expect: unsupported_city at once, no model call

inputs.expect: published at the intersection a found 2026 source names, quotes verified
